chat.title: WhatsApp bot
chat.intro: Connect one WhatsApp number, through Lead Intel, to a bot that answers questions about Ziira: what it is, the plans and prices and how to sign up. It gives the same checked answers as the chat on the website.
chat.readOnly: You can look at this page but only a super admin can change it.
chat.loadFailed: The WhatsApp bot page could not be read
chat.practice: Practice mode: no real service is called. A practice provider plays the whole story so you can try every step. Nothing is sent to anyone.

bot.nowOff: The bot is off. It will not answer.

notReady.key: Paste and test the Lead Intel key first.

key.title: Lead Intel key
key.intro: Paste the platform key from your Lead Intel account. It is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
key.label: Lead Intel platform key
key.hint: Not shown after you save it. Paste a new one any time to replace it.
key.keep: Saved. Paste a new key to replace it

connect.title: Connect your number
connect.intro: This is the WhatsApp number people will write to.

progress.pending: Lead Intel is setting the number up. This page checks every few seconds.

connect.codeHint: The 6-digit code that arrived on that number.
connect.failedFallback: Lead Intel could not connect the number.
connect.cancelled: The request was cancelled. You can start again.

modeHints.new: For a number that is not on Lead Intel yet. A number that was submitted before cannot be submitted again, and the name people see must follow Meta's rules for verified names.
modeHints.existing: For a number that is already on Lead Intel. They send a code to that number and you type it here.

connect.displayHint: The name people see. Meta limits what is allowed.
connect.metaNote: Meta checks the profile name. If it is refused you will see Lead Intel's reason here.
connect.needKey: Save and test the key in step 1 first.
connect.disconnectText: This removes {{number}} from Lead Intel and stops the bot. People who write to it will get no answer.

find.title: Find an existing connection
find.intro: Use this if the number is already connected on Lead Intel (for example after a set-up that was interrupted). It is pointed at this platform again.
find.foundInactive: A connection exists but it is not active.
find.notFound: No connection was found for that number.

webhook.title: Where Lead Intel sends messages
webhook.intro: Lead Intel calls this address for every message. The address and the signing secret are made and sent to Lead Intel by the server.
webhook.hidden: The secret part of the address is hidden. You never need to copy it.

problems.empty: The platform's public API address is empty. Set it in Platform settings first.
problems.notHttps: The public API address must start with https:// for Lead Intel to call it.

webhook.rotated: A new secret and address were sent to Lead Intel.
webhook.rotateText: A new address and a new secret are made and given to Lead Intel. The old ones stop working at once.

say.title: What the bot says
say.intro: Leave a text empty to use the built-in words (English or Swahili, to match the person).
say.welcomeHint: Shown with three buttons: See prices, How to sign up, Talk to a person.
say.handoff: When someone asks for a person
say.handoffHint: Sent after the request is recorded.
say.offHoursHint: Used instead of the text on the left when it is outside the hours below.
say.languageHint: Automatic follows the language the person writes in.
say.hoursHint: Monday to Friday. Leave the times empty if a person is always available.
say.profileWarning: Saved here, but Lead Intel did not take the profile: {{reason}}

try.title: Try it
try.intro: See what the bot would say, exactly as it would arrive on a phone. Nothing is sent.
try.question: A question
try.testHint: Sends one real message. WhatsApp only allows it if that number wrote to the bot in the last 24 hours.

waiting.title: Waiting for a person
waiting.intro: People who pressed Talk to a person. Numbers are hidden in part. Answer them in Lead Intel's inbox.
waiting.emptyHint: Requests for a person appear here.
waiting.lastConversations: Outcome of the last {{count}} conversations (counts only)

dev.title: Practice: send a message to the bot
dev.intro: Practice mode only. This sends a signed message from a made-up sender through the real inbound path.
